blurb: Solera Brewery crafts unique, one of a kind beers in small batches on a 7bbl system. Guests can enjoy a changing tap list including the year-round Hedonist IPA, with options to taste or get a taster tray. The brewery offers a friendly environment with indoor and outdoor seating, food menu, and views of Mt. Hood.
extraNote: No reservations; tables first come, first served · Private events possible on Wednesdays by arrangement via email · At the brewery on Baseline Dr. in downtown Parkdale, OR
